hint.ru: Автомобиль спереди целиком, камера по центру.
hint.en: Photograph the entire car from the front.

hint.ru: Автомобиль сзади целиком, камера по центру.
hint.en: Photograph the entire car from the rear.

hint.ru: Снимите левую сторону целиком, слева по ходу движения.
hint.en: Photograph the complete vehicle left side, relative to forward travel.

hint.ru: Снимите правую сторону целиком, справа по ходу движения.
hint.en: Photograph the complete vehicle right side, relative to forward travel.

hint.ru: Добавьте отдельный резкий снимок панели кузова и ЛКП при ровном освещении.
hint.en: Add a separate sharp, well-lit close-up of a body panel and paintwork.

hint.ru: Снимите передние сиденья и пространство переднего ряда.
hint.en: Photograph the front seats and front cabin.

hint.ru: Снимите читаемое показание пробега на приборной панели.
hint.en: Photograph a legible mileage reading on the instrument cluster.

hint.ru: Откройте багажник и снимите пространство внутри.
hint.en: Open the trunk and photograph the cargo space.

hint.ru: Откройте капот и снимите моторный отсек.
hint.en: Open the hood and photograph the engine bay.

hint.ru: Снимите колесо и протектор шины крупным планом.
hint.en: Photograph a wheel and tire tread close-up.

hint.ru: Если есть повреждения, добавьте их крупные планы.
hint.en: If any damage exists, add close-up photographs of it.

front: a photo of the front of a car, headlights and front grille visible
a head-on front view of a parked automobile
rear: a photo of the rear of a car with taillights and trunk lid
a straight rear view of a parked automobile
left_side: a full left side profile of a car, front pointing left
a photo of the driver side profile of a left hand drive car
right_side: a full right side profile of a car, front pointing right
a photo of the passenger side profile of a left hand drive car
body_condition: a detailed close-up photograph of car body panel paintwork condition
a sharp close-up of the paint surface of a car door or fender
interior_front: a photograph of the front seats inside a car cabin
a view inside a car showing the front seating row
interior_rear: a photograph of the rear seats inside a car
a view of the back seating row of an automobile interior
dashboard: a photo of a car dashboard with steering wheel and instrument panel
a wide view of an automobile dashboard and center console
odometer: a close-up of the car odometer mileage display
a close-up photograph of the instrument cluster showing mileage
trunk: a photograph of an open car trunk cargo space
the inside of a car luggage compartment with trunk open
engine_bay: a photo of a car engine bay with the hood open
a view under the open hood showing an automobile engine
wheels: a close-up photograph of a car wheel and tire tread
a detailed photo of an automobile tire and wheel rim
exterior_details: a close-up photo of a car headlight or side mirror
a detailed photo of automobile exterior trim
damage: a close-up photograph of a scratched dented damaged car body panel
a photo of visible collision damage or scratches on a car
front_left: a front left three-quarter view of a complete car
a parked automobile photographed diagonally from the front left corner
front_right: a front right three-quarter view of a complete car
a parked automobile photographed diagonally from the front right corner
rear_left: a rear left three-quarter view of a complete car
a parked automobile photographed diagonally from the rear left corner
rear_right: a rear right three-quarter view of a complete car
a parked automobile photographed diagonally from the rear right corner
other: a photo of a person, animal, food, document, or landscape without a car
a screenshot, drawing, advertisement or unrelated object

ru.duplicates: Несколько фотографий повторяются. Добавьте другие ракурсы.
ru.quality: Некоторые фотографии нечёткие или плохо различимы. Переснимите их.
ru.uncertain: Не удалось уверенно определить содержимое части фотографий. Добавьте более понятные снимки.

en.duplicates: Some photographs repeat. Add other viewpoints.
en.quality: Some photographs are unclear. Please retake them.
en.uncertain: Some photographs could not be recognized reliably. Add clearer views.
